entities.summary: George Thomas Whitesides is an American politician and businessman who has served as the U.S. representative for California's 27th congressional district since 2025. He was previously chief of staff at NASA and CEO of Virgin Galactic. He is a member of the Democratic Party. George T. Whitesides was a performers & entertainers from Massachusetts (b. 1974-03-03, Massachusetts). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
